title: Synthetic FIX 4.4 projection with missing side evidence
attribution: Synthetic fixture authored by the WeaveTrail contributors from the cited published FIX schema.

syntheticity.values: Every value is synthetic, including execution IDs, timestamps, instrument, account identifiers, prices and quantities.
syntheticity.entities: ZZ79X1 and every SYNTH-ACCOUNT identifier are fictional. No real issuer, customer, account, order or production system is represented.
syntheticity.marketData: No market data was retrieved, committed, redistributed or used to choose these values.

derivation.description: The CSV projects selected FIX 4.4 ExecutionReport fields over invented values but deliberately carries no Side(54) column. The omission is source evidence, not an inferred side: all four normalized in-window trades therefore remain unclassifiable to RAPID_PRICE_LIFT.
takenFromSpecifications: FIX field names and numeric tags
FIX Price and Qty decimal notation

absentFields.reason: The committed source deliberately omits FIX Side(54) to exercise missing classification evidence.
absentFields.workbenchHandling: Normalization does not invent a side. RAPID_PRICE_LIFT counts each in-window trade as non-comparable and returns INCONCLUSIVE.
